title: Stainedglass Duo #15
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side.

#1: leaded-glass platform boots 8 inch, the same dense small-pane mosaic continuing unbroken onto the shoe, extra long stiletto nails to match.

#2: leaded-glass platform boots 8 inch, the same dense small-pane mosaic continuing unbroken onto the shoe, extra long stiletto nails to match.

Environment: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient.
All: extreme high-gloss glass finish, hundreds of small panes visible on every woman, never large sheets, never a solid uniform colour block anywhere. CRITICAL: all 2 women's legs must show FULL BODY ART coverage from hip to ankle to toe with NO bare untattooed skin visible anywhere, the glass solid and curved throughout, never flat. TWO completely different extreme physiques must CONTRAST and DOMINATE every inch of frame. 8K 3:4 aspect ratio.
